newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher, specs cover shorts.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher, specs cover shorts.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures pierced resistance late in the session and closed just under the day's highs, buoyed by speculative short-covering and fund buying, floor sources said.
March options expiry on Friday kept dealings thin for most of the session, but activity accelerated once the March contract broke through key 10.60 cents, they added.
The March contract settled 0.12 cent higher to 10.63, having ranged from 10.65 to 10.47 cents. The outer months closed 0.15 to 0.10 firmer.
The May contract settled at a 0.05 cent premium to March compared with 0.02 cent on Monday's close.

Early, the March contract filled a gap on the charts between 10.46 and 10.49 and then rose to resistance. Trade selling and fund rolling of March contracts into May limited gains by midsession but the contract managed to climb to the day's high of 10.65 cents near the close.
Market sources viewed the close as positive for prices and set the next level of resistance at 10.70 cents in March, where additional fund buying could emerge.
Support remained at 10.47 and then at 10.40 cents in March.
Open interest in March stood at 52,373 lots as of Monday's close, down 2,223 lots.
